text: /* @component: .js-container-input */ (function () { function initInputs() { document.querySelectorAll('fieldset').forEach(function (fs) { if (fs.dataset.init === 'true') return; fs.dataset.init = 'true'; const label = fs.querySelector('label'); const legendSpan = fs.querySelector('legend span'); if (label && legendSpan) { legendSpan.textContent = label.textContent; } }); } if (document.readyState === 'loading') { document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initInputs); } else { initInputs(); } })(); /* @end: .js-container-input */
